name: Apple Managed Apple Account
aliases: Apple Managed Apple Account (Apple School Manager), 200 GB

card.provider: Apple Managed Apple Account (Apple School Manager), 200 GB
card.summary: 200 GB of free iCloud storage per Managed Apple Account, for every student and every teacher, federated with Microsoft Entra or Google Workspace

record.provider: Apple Managed Apple Account (Apple School Manager), 200 GB

free_tier.stated: 200 GB of free iCloud storage per Managed Apple Account, for every student and every teacher, federated with Microsoft Entra or Google Workspace

retention.stated: The account is owned by the school. Managed Apple Accounts cannot be converted to personal ones and vice versa, so the bytes are not portable on graduation

egress.terms: Normal iCloud egress, with no metering on download

record.tooling: none. iCloud Drive for Managed Apple Accounts is reachable only through iCloud for Windows, the web app, or a managed device: there is no CloudKit-for-drive path and no WebDAV. This is the blocker, not the quota
record.chaining: 200 GB times N accounts, where every account needs a school. Since no programmatic read path exists, the capacity cannot enter any programmatic stack

limits.value: enrolment in Apple School Manager is a prerequisite for every account

identity_cost.detail: an institution enrolled in Apple School Manager. The docs state Managed Apple IDs are created and owned by the school

record.reliability_note: The account is owned by the institution, so the bytes are not yours and do not survive leaving it. 200 GB is also below a 500 GB threshold unless multiplied, and no API exists to multiply it with

evidence.proved: '升级的 iCloud 储存空间。管理式 Apple ID 可享用 200GB 的免费 iCloud 储存空间'
'Managed Apple IDs are owned and controlled by the school'
the 5 GB to 200 GB change for students and teachers
a current Apple page states 200 GB per Managed Apple Account; the PDF it replaces is dated 2019
evidence.quote: Every Managed Apple Account is given 200 gigabytes (GB) of iCloud Drive storage.

evidence.proved: each Managed Apple Account has 200 GB of iCloud Drive storage
evidence.quote: Every Managed Apple Account is given 200 gigabytes (GB) of iCloud Drive storage.

evidence.proved: the account is owned by the school or district
evidence.quote: Unlike a personal account, a Managed Apple Account is owned and controlled by a school or district.

evidence.proved: 200 GB of free iCloud storage for each Managed Apple Account
evidence.quote: along with 200 gigabytes (GB) of free iCloud storage for each Managed Apple Account

evidence.proved: Apple School Manager federates with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID or an identity provider
evidence.quote: You can link to Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, or your IdP, but only one at a time.

record.binding_note: The quota is real and 200 GB is respectable, but the account belongs to a school and the interface list is empty. Either the identity gate or the absent API would stop it alone.
record.notes: A faculty member could obtain this; an individual registrant cannot, and even with a school the bytes are not portable.
